ball-bearings.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
ball-bearings.description: Cover a 10-foot-square area; moving creatures must make a DC 10 Dex saving throw or fall prone.

caltrops.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
caltrops.description: Cover a 5-foot square. Entering creatures take 1 piercing damage and lose 10 ft speed on failed DC 15 Dex save.

chain.name: Chain (10 feet)
chain.description: A heavy 10-foot iron chain with 10 HP; burst with DC 20 Strength check.

chalk.name: Chalk (1 piece)
chalk.description: A stick of soft white limestone chalk for marking stone or wood.

spikes-iron.name: Spikes, Iron (10)
spikes-iron.description: Ten heavy iron wedges for spiking doors shut or wedging traps.

pole.name: Pole (10-foot)
pole.description: A 10-foot wooden pole used to prod floors for pit traps or test depths.

holy-water.name: Holy Water (flask)
holy-water.description: Water blessed by a priest. Deals 2d6 radiant damage to fiends or undead on hit.

acid.name: Acid (vial)
acid.description: As an action, splash this vial on a target within 5 feet or throw it up to 20 feet. Deals 2d6 acid damage on hit.

alchemists-fire.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
alchemists-fire.description: Sticky fluid that ignites when exposed to air. Deals 1d4 fire damage per turn until extinguished.

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin (vial)
antitoxin.description: Drinking this liquid grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

alchemical.effectDescription: Advantage on poison saving throws for 1 hour.

basic-poison.name: Poison, Basic (vial)
basic-poison.description: Apply to weapon or ammunition; struck creature must make DC 10 Con save or take 1d4 poison damage.

oil.name: Oil (flask)
oil.description: Pint of combustible lamp oil. Burns for 6 hours or covers 5-foot square dealing 5 fire damage when ignited.

tent.name: Tent, Two-Person
tent.description: A canvas shelter with collapsible poles accommodating two medium travelers.
